opportunities.title: Fulbright Scholar Awards to the USA

amount.raw: Generous monthly stipends (vary from year to year and by award)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based academics and other professionals. Non-UK citizens based in and committed to a life and career in the UK may be considered if not able to apply through their country of citizenship. Preference to applicants without extensive (6 months+) prior US experience.
opportunities.summary: The only scholarships available to UK-based academics and professionals to lecture and/or research in any discipline at any accredited US university. Grant periods typically 3-6 months, with some partner awards up to an academic year. Includes monthly stipends, sickness/accident coverage, visa and logistical support. Applications opened 20 July 2026 for academic year 2027-28.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Scholar Awards for UK professionals
opportunities.summary: Scholarships for mid-late career professionals partnered with professional or charitable bodies, as well as awards in specific disciplines, to research/teach in the USA. Includes monthly stipends, sickness/accident coverage, J-1 visa sponsorship and pre-departure support. Page states applications for 2025-26 are closed and will open for academic year 2026-27 in August.
